plan.promotion_rule: At least 20% median paired throughput improvement or TTFT-proxy reduction, improvement in all three pairs for the winning metric, no more than 5% median regression in the other metric, all quality/placement/memory checks pass
plan.comparison_scope: Whole configuration; GPU expert tier only changes, UMA shared memory; CPU fresh reference is one start; OS cache uncontrolled, no forced eviction
plan.demo: Same Rust Fibonacci prompt, candidate 32 GiB tier, exactly 30s with accelerated source clock

metric: Whole measured HTTP batch completion throughput including prefill/HTTP; TTFT proxy is first nonempty output

runs.cache_state: fresh engine/LRU; OS page cache uncontrolled
runs.io_mode: explicit buffered reads (G53_DIRECT=0); no global cache flush
runs.rss_caution: RSS sums may double-count shared pages; global MemAvailable is recorded separately
runs.counter_scope: Native engine cumulative expert counters through each HTTP turn; GPU and CPU-cache denominators differ

decision.interpretation: Three paired server starts; descriptive evidence, not a statistical significance claim

limitations: One Thor and two short synthetic prompts; not a model quality benchmark
Four requests within each server start are correlated; independent repetitions are server starts
Three alternated pairs, uncontrolled OS page cache and concurrent user-service I/O; no cold-SSD or statistical-significance claim
Only requested GPU expert-tier budget changes between the two CUDA profiles; shared UMA allocations still interact
CPU reference is one fresh server start; historical baseline is context, not the tuning gain denominator
